title: Network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure accepted by the UE

entities.name: Network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure accepted by the UE
entities.description: Procedure where the UE accepts network slice-specific authentication and authorization by creating and sending a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message containing EAP-response and S-NSSAI.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to indicate completion of network slice-specific authentication, containing EAP message and S-NSSAI IEs.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element carrying the EAP-response message provided by upper layers.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Information element identifying the network slice (HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI) associated with the EAP-response.

entities.name: T3575
entities.description: Timer running in the AMF for the network slice-specific authentication procedure, stopped upon receipt of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE.

entities.name: Upper layers provide EAP-response message
entities.description: Condition triggering the UE to create the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message when upper layers provide an EAP-response associated with HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI.

entities.name: Transparent to 5GMM layer
entities.description: Property indicating that the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is transparent to the UE's 5GMM layer except for sending the completion message.

relations.description: The procedure includes the step of creating and sending the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
The message contains the EAP message IE set to the EAP-response provided by upper layers.
The message contains the S-NSSAI IE set to the HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI associated with the EAP-response.
The condition of upper layers providing an EAP-response triggers the creation of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
Receipt of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message by the AMF stops timer T3575.
The procedure is transparent to the 5GMM layer of the UE except for sending the completion message.
